text:
The Rangers arrive in Ottawa after a 5-4 loss at Toronto, where Troy Stecher scored the winner with 0:28 left. They're 2-2-1 in their last five, outscored 16-14, and Igor Shesterkin is on injured reserve. The Senators are 2-3-0 in their last five after a 6-2 home loss to San Jose, and they are playing without Thomas Chabot and William Eklund. With Eklund out, Warren Foegele has moved in beside Cozens and Zetterlund, and Drake Batherson is up to 18:44 a night from 16:37.

The teams look close. At five on five, NYR has taken 51% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its games and OTT 52%, and our model has tonight at 2.97 for OTT and 2.89 for NYR. Ottawa's penalty problem stands out: 5.1 penalties a game keeps handing opponents power plays. Dylan Garand is the projected NYR goalie, at .915 this season with 2.18 goals saved above expected (how many goals he's kept out compared with an average goalie facing the same shots), and 3.88 in three games last season. Ottawa's projected starter isn't listed.

Alexis Lafrenière is worth watching for NYR, with a 31% chance to score and 60% to get a point, after a hot stretch that the chances back up. For OTT, Tim Stützle leads at 34% to score and 75% to get a point, with Batherson at 30% and 60%.
